about.title: About Me
bio: I'm a Software Engineer focused on distributed systems, cloud architecture, and AI-driven development.
My path started with full-stack product work at Tribuu Technologies, then grew into several parallel roles.
At Loopay I've had two stints — Full Stack Developer from 2023 and Senior Software Engineer today — building end-to-end platforms with React, NestJS, and PostgreSQL on AWS and GCP.
In parallel, I've built transactional BFF and financial risk services at Galgo, plus hybrid mobile apps and real-time systems at Trebet.
I care about modular, SOLID code — and I practice spec-driven development with AI tooling to ship faster without sacrificing quality.
